headline: Patriots' A.J. Brown has career-high 3 dropped passes in return from injury
summary: Patriots receiver A.J. Brown, coming off a right high ankle sprain that sidelined him four weeks, had a shaky return to action Sunday, dropping a career-high three passes in the team's win over the Jets

headline: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey ruled out with concussion vs. Chiefs
summary: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey, in his first action since injuring his foot in Week 4, left Sunday's game early after suffering a concussion in the second quarter.

headline: Giants QB J.J. McCarthy Replaces Jameis Winston
summary: J.J. McCarthy made his Giants debut in Week 5, playing five snaps. Heading into today’s game, head coach John Harbaugh made it clear the trade acquisition could see more playing time moving forward. headline: Falcons say Kendal Daniels is alert and has movement in all his extremities
summary: Falcons linebacker Kendal Daniels suffered a scary injury during today's loss to the Bears, but the Falcons offered some good news after the game.

headline: Jerry Jeudy, amid trade buzz, has clutch catch in Browns' win, gets game ball
summary: Browns wide receiver Jerry Jeudy had a clutch catch in Cleveland's game-winning drive Sunday, earning a game ball from coach Todd Monken.

headline: Jeffery Simmons' halftime message, play help Titans stun Colts, get 1st win
summary: Robert Saleh said it was said it was Jeffrey Simmons' play and halftime actions that inspired the Titans to their first win of the season.
